# Arshan Aslam — AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

> Software engineer with 5+ years of experience building production-grade AI systems, cloud-native backends, and full-stack SaaS products. Based in Lahore, Pakistan. Available for freelance AI engineering projects.

## About

Arshan Aslam is an AI Engineer and Full-Stack Developer specialising in the intersection of artificial intelligence and production software. He builds RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, HIPAA-compliant backends, and scalable cloud-native applications. Currently working remotely with DigiPops (US).
